lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly five observable horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with higher density in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct checkerboard-like grid pattern on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae running parallel to the body axis, displaying a sharp luminance transition with light-reflecting upper surfaces and shadowed ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct elongated features with high-intensity profiles indicative of remoras (Echeneidae) situated near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
